name: @gogymgo/platform
description: GoGymGo member app, landing site, admin dashboard, API and cloud platform.

scripts.build: npm run contracts:generate && npm run build --workspace @gogymgo/brand && npm run build --workspace @gogymgo/contracts && npm run build --workspace @gogymgo/api && npm run build --workspace @gogymgo/admin && npm run build --workspace @gogymgo/landing && npm run build --workspace @gogymgo/member-app
scripts.check: npm run check:governance && npm run contracts:check && npm run check --workspace @gogymgo/brand && npm run check --workspace @gogymgo/member-app && npm run check --workspace @gogymgo/api && npm run check --workspace @gogymgo/admin && npm run check --workspace @gogymgo/landing
scripts.check:governance: npm run check:architecture && node --test tooling/dependency-risk-policy.test.mjs tooling/deployment-source-policy.test.mjs tooling/member-release-policy.test.mjs tooling/member-release-workflow.test.mjs tooling/static-export-attestation.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @gogymgo/member-app && npm run test --workspace @gogymgo/api && npm run test --workspace @gogymgo/admin && npm run test --workspace @gogymgo/landing
scripts.test:journeys: npm run test:journeys --workspace @gogymgo/member-app && npm run test:journeys --workspace @gogymgo/admin
